reason: The v02 report described the wrong level program for B1-B5.
The v02 massing elongated the north-south/front-to-rear axis instead of the east-west/left-to-right axis shown in the approved flight-deck plan.
The rear station source was treated as an extension behind the fortress instead of as the opposite rear face of one rectangular building.
L1, L2, B1, B3, B4 and B5 were genericized and no longer matched the established Site 0 architecture.
The full stair/passenger/freight/V1/V2 bypass logic was not captured.
